title: Photos of the Week: Rabbit Jumping, Floating Bazaar, Chief Mouser
text:
İlkin Eskipehlivan / Anadolu / Getty

 Traditional clothes and designs created by designers from across the Turkic world were showcased during the Cappadocia leg of the ninth Türksoy Women and Ethno-Fashion Meeting in Ürgüp, Nevşehir, Turkey, on October 9, 2026.

 Hameraldi Agolli / AP

 A riot police officer detains an injured protester during clashes near the Ministry of Education in Tirana, Albania, on October 13, 2026, joining a demonstration organized by the Flamingo protest movement demanding the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama.

 Florion Goga / Reuters

 A person walks past a burning kiosk during clashes between police and demonstrators amid an anti-government protest by students in Tirana on October 15, 2026.

 Bruno Kelly / Reuters

 A deforested area of the Amazon rainforest burns during the dry season in the municipality of Autazes, in the state of Amazonas, Brazil, on October 12, 2026.

 Kiko Sierich / Reuters

 A walkway, closed for safety reasons, photographed during high water flow at Iguazu Falls in Foz do Iguaçu, Paraná state, Brazil, on October 13, 2026

 Jae C. Hong / AP

 Waves from Post-Tropical Storm Rachel crash into damaged beachfront homes in Long Beach, California, on October 12, 2026.

 Johannes Christo / Reuters

 Motorcyclists queue to refuel at a petrol station amid a fuel-supply shortage in Badung, Bali, Indonesia, on October 15, 2026.

 Alberto Pizzoli / AFP / Getty

 Boats sail past Vittoria Light lighthouse at the start of the 58th Barcolana sailing regatta in the Gulf of Trieste on October 11, 2026.

 Edmar Barros / AP

 The Jornalista Phelippe Daou Bridge is shrouded in smoke from wildfires in Manaus, Amazonas state, Brazil, on October 9, 2026.

 Jeff Chiu / AP

 The U.S. Navy Blue Angels fly during the San Francisco Fleet Week Air Show, on October 9, 2026.

 David Swanson / AFP / Getty

 An L.A. County Fire helicopter flies above crews fighting the Bike Fire on the outskirts of Santa Clarita, California, on October 11, 2026.

 AFP / Getty

 Migratory birds perch on a power-transmission tower on the Yellow River floodplain in Yueyahu township in Yinchuan, in China’s northern Ningxia region, on October 10, 2026.

 Fernando Llano / AP

 The Flying Men of Papantla perform the “ Danza de los Voladores ” on the beach as Hurricane Simon approaches Puerto Vallarta, Mexico, on October 10, 2026.

 Halil Sagirkaya / Anadolu / Getty

 The Wuppertaler Schwebebahn suspension railway carries passengers above the Wupper River in Wuppertal, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany, on October 11, 2026.

 Ellen Schmidt / AP

 Bryanna Sarmiento cruises on the Stillwater Lift Bridge in her electric car during the annual Harvest Festival in Stillwater, Minnesota, on October 11, 2026.

 AFP / Getty

 An aquaculture worker navigates a boat through an abalone-farming area to carry out maintenance work in Guanwu village, Lianjiang county, in China’s Fujian province, on October 13, 2026.

 Thein Zaw / AP

 Locals row their boats at a local floating bazaar in Inle Lake, Shan State, Myanmar, on October 13, 2026.

 Juni Kriswanto / AFP / Getty

 Members of the Australian Defence Force take part in the “Keris Woomera” joint military drills with Indonesian marines at Banongan beach in Situbondo on October 15, 2026.

 Khaled Desouki / AFP / Getty

 A car-shaped river taxi cruises along the Nile River in central Cairo, Egypt, on October 15, 2026.

 Sam Bagnall / Sutton Images / Getty

 Sparks fly behind Pierre Gasly during sprint qualifying ahead of the F1 Grand Prix of Singapore at Marina Bay Street Circuit on October 9, 2026.

 VCG / Getty

 Tourists visit a workshop at the Shen Guanglong Sword Casting Park to observe traditional sword-forging techniques on October 10, 2026, in Lishui, Zhejiang province, China.

 Ian Forsyth / Getty

 Red deer stags battle each other during the annual rut at Raby Castle on October 11, 2026, in Staindrop, England.

 David Ebener / DPA / Getty

 A life-size Camarasaurus made of steel and concrete is transported from its previous location at the Barkhausen dinosaur trails in Bad Essen to Damme, Germany, on October 11, 2026.

 Jonathan Nackstrand / AFP / Getty

 A rabbit hops over an obstacle as its handler guides it during the long-jump competition at the European Rabbit Jumping Championships in Lysekil, Sweden, on October 9, 2026. The three-day championship featured several disciplines, including straight-course jumping and high jump.

 Henry Nicholls / AFP / Getty

 Larry the cat, the chief mouser to the Cabinet Office, poses outside 10 Downing Street, the official residence of Britain’s prime minister, on October 14, 2026.

 Jeff J Mitchell / Getty

 A handler pets a cow at the 129th Highland Cattle Society autumn show and sale on October 11, 2026, in Oban, Scotland.

 Ulises Ruiz / AFP / Getty

 An aerial view of the Zona Romántica (“Romantic Zone”), a tourist district in Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco state, Mexico, seen on October 12, 2026

 Sergei Gapon / AFP / Getty

 Tourists take a traditional rafting trip on the Dunajec River aboard a wooden raft guided by local raftsmen near the village of Sromowce Niżne, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland, on October 13, 2026.
